title: Formosa Craft & Culture Odyssey: An 9-Day Taiwan Deep Dive
subtitle: From tea-scented mountain peaks to coastal rock formations, experiencing the perfect fusion of traditional craftsmanship and modern creativity

days.title: Departure: Las Vegas to Seattle
days.details: Fly from Las Vegas to Seattle on Alaska Airlines flight AS 749, beginning your cross-Pacific journey to Taiwan. Please arrive at LAS Airport early to complete check-in and baggage drop.

days.title: Trans-Pacific Flight: Seattle Nonstop to Taipei
days.details: Depart Seattle in the early morning on STARLUX Airlines flight JX 31 to Taipei, arriving in Taiwan early on March 15. Rest on board and adjust to the time difference as you prepare for the upcoming itinerary.

days.title: Exchange, Explore, and Savor Taiwan: A Journey Through Classic Humanities and Mountain Towns
days.details: Head to Kang Chiao International School in the morning for cross-border student exchange. Enjoy a palace-level buffet lunch at The Grand Hotel. In the afternoon, visit Jiufen Old Street to savor the retro mountain town scenery, and head to Shifen Old Street in the evening to experience releasing sky lanterns for blessings.

days.title: Volunteer Service × Old Street Exploration: Discovering Taiwan's Hospitality and Scenery in Action
days.details: Participate in meaningful campus volunteer service at Dayuan Elementary School in the morning. In the afternoon, stroll along the 17km Coastline and Nanliao Fishing Port to enjoy the west coast scenery. In the evening, step into the Hsinchu City God Temple to explore century-old beliefs and the surrounding old streets.

days.title: Tech Tour × Indigenous Culture Exploration: From Global Wafer Hub to Scenic Humanities
days.details: Visit TSMC in the morning to witness the global semiconductor miracle, then drive to Sun Moon Lake for a ropeway ride. In the afternoon, enter the Formosan Aboriginal Culture Village and Ita Thao Tribe to immerse in the traditional culture and architecture of indigenous peoples.

days.title: Scenic Lakes × Craft Heritage × Marine Ecology: Stepping into Taiwan's Authentic Nature and Humanities
days.details: Take a morning boat tour to enjoy the scenic beauty of Sun Moon Lake, followed by a century-old papermaking DIY experience at Guangxing Paper Mill. In the afternoon, ride an oyster picking cart deep into the intertidal zone to explore and taste charcoal-grilled oysters. Head to Chiayi Wenhua Road Night Market in the evening to savor local street food.

days.title: Alishan Forest Culture and Tsou Tribe Experience
days.details: Drive along the Alishan Highway to admire the magnificent sea of clouds and tea gardens. Venture into the YUYUPAS tribe to experience Tsou culture, music, and dance. Descend the mountain in the afternoon to visit Hinoki Village, enjoying a tranquil time in Taiwan's largest Japanese-style wooden architectural complex.

days.title: High-Speed Rail Transit and Cultural DIY Aesthetics
days.details: Experience city transit at 300 km/h on the High-Speed Rail. Head to the Kuo Yuan Ye Museum of Cake and Pastry to experience Pineapple Cake DIY and learn about traditional wedding culture. Arrive at TaiMall Shopping Center in the evening to enjoy modern urban fashion shopping.

days.title: Exotic Vibes in Taiwan, Yunnan Stories, Ceramics Experience, and Old Street Tour
days.details: Visit Zhongzhen New Village in the morning to experience the exotic history and culture of the Golden Triangle. In the afternoon, wander through Yingge Old Street and enjoy a hands-on pottery DIY experience. Head to Taoyuan Airport in the evening with a heart full of memories for the flight home.
